generated.details: On the left tabletop, behind the plate and clear of the laptop, the ivory ceramic coffee cup has a rounded bowl, thick rim and loop handle joined at both ends, with coffee below the rim.
Beside the laptop along the near edge, the small ivory pastry plate has a shallow well and raised rim, its outer left rim cropped.
One croissant rests in the plate's well, with a curved tapered body and overlapping flaky baked layers.
Its padded panels join a continuous upholstered bench frame, with the seat hidden behind the table.
